cd /workspace && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import json, random, subprocess, sys, time, resource
from collections import Counter
r = random.Random(11)
C,E,W,K,F = 8,4,2,2,8
cfg = {"slots":1,"window":2,"idle_timeout":2,"len_quantum":1,"gap_quantum":1,
       "rate_num":10**6,"rate_den":1,"bucket_capacity":512,"initial_tokens":512,
       "pending_capacity":512,"lanes":4,"service":[1]*C,"fallback":0,
       "time_edges":[0],"count_edges":[0],"probability":[[65536]]}
mdl = {"classes":C,"embedding_dim":E,
       "length_embedding":[[r.randint(-128,127) for _ in range(E)] for _ in range(16)],
       "gap_embedding":[[r.randint(-128,127) for _ in range(E)] for _ in range(16)],
       "kernel":K,
       "conv_weights":[[[r.randint(-128,127) for _ in range(2*E)] for _ in range(K)] for _ in range(F)],
       "conv_bias":[r.randint(-10**6,10**6) for _ in range(F)],
       "conv_shift":[4]*F,
       "dense_weights":[[r.randint(-128,127) for _ in range(F)] for _ in range(C)],
       "dense_bias":[r.randint(-10**6,10**6) for _ in range(C)]}
conns=[{"id":"c%04d"%i,"slot":0,"label":i%C,"split":"dev" if i%2 else "eval"} for i in range(40)]
pk=[];t=0
for i in range(20000):
    t += r.choice([0,0,1,1,2,3])
    pk.append({"time":t,"connection":"c%04d"%r.randrange(40),"length":r.randint(0,65535),"draw":0})
doc={"version":1,"config":cfg,"model":mdl,"connections":conns,"packets":pk}
open("tmp/st2_collide.json","w").write(json.dumps(doc))
t0=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"submission/main.py"],stdin=open("tmp/st2_collide.json","rb"),capture_output=True)
d=json.loads(p.stdout)
print("collide wall %.2f"%(time.time()-t0),"outbytes",len(p.stdout),"jobs",len(d["jobs"]),
      Counter(x["decision"] for x in d["packets"]), Counter(j["status"] for j in d["jobs"]),
      Counter(x["generation"] for x in d["packets"]).most_common(3),
      "rss MB %.1f"%(resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss/1024.0))
PYEOF
